eps.d: Dr. Gangreen invents a whistle that makes tomatoes attack. Igor and Zoltan kidnap Whitley White and Igor fills in as "Substitute Anchor Man" on Whitley's show. Chad stumbles onto the kidnapping while delivering a pizza and ends up getting kidnapped himself. F.T. and Wilbur soon rescue Chad and Whitley and they quickly hatch a plan to stop Dr. Gangreen from playing his whistle on television.
Dr. Gangreen creates a new "Itty bitty cherry tomato" that grows bigger when it eats. Soon giant tomatoes invade San Zucchini is over run and it's up to Chad, Wilbur, Tara and F.T to save the day.
F.T. and Tara are on the way to the Black Lagoon but they did not know is that the Tomato Link hides in the depth of the swamp: He captures Tara.
Dr. Gangrene has built a new tomato. An Elvis-like person who is Tara's new idol.
Martians that like tomatoes have come to Earth. They want mutated seeds from Gangreen. Chad, Tara and FT are their only hope.

Dr. Gangreen reveals the story of a childhood enemy named Sidney Igotcha whose tricks led to Gangreen's obsession with tomatoes. Now he's back and created a new enemy aimed at his own attempts at world conquest.

To take zombie turned citizens back to normal, Chad and Whitby must undo the spell Dr. Gangreen spread all over Sam Zucchini's town via zombie virus, by going into the town's TV station and finding their tomato-selves.
Chad and Tara must rescue the Tomato Task Force from the Tomato Terminator in the 23rd Century with the help of an eclectic star ship crew.

Chad and Tara head to summer camp for two weeks where she is picked on by two mean girls. Dr. Gangreen plans to exploit Tara's hurt feelings by promising to make her fully human if she helps him control the largest tomato monster yet.

On a night of Halloween, a post-modernist American Dracula named "Spatula" visits a Florida town to turn every tomato into blood sucking vampires. What could Sam Zucchini, a humble pizza maker, do to save his town from tomato vampires?

Wilbur's pizza delivery truck falls off a cliff in Death Valley as he was taking Tara, Chad and F.T. to the top secret Tomato Task Force field training. The only place stay for the night is the Frankenstem's Horror Castle.

eps.t: The Gang That Couldn't Squirt Straight
eps.d: After a plot to splatter Chad with tomatoes goes awry, Zoltan and the Gang of Five rebel against Dr. Gangreen and take up racketeering to enslave some of San Zucchini's businesses.
Dr. Gangrene creates a group of tomato sharks. The Tomato Task Force can't stop them from wreaking havoc on San Zucchini harbor. It's up to Chad, Tara and F.T. to blast the tomatoes.
Dr. Gangreen's latest scheme involves mutating Zoltan and his new Gang of Six into credible threats to conquer Earth one continent at a time.
After succeeding in his goal to conquer the world, Dr. Gangreen attains inner peace and releases the Tomato Task Force from his dungeon, which leads to his own creations turning on him.
Dr. Gangreen is missing and the KTTF splits up to find him. Tara travels to Paris, France to locate him but only manages to locate the Phantomato of the Opera. Is he friend or foe?

Will the Killer Tomato Task Force join Gangreen and Igor in an uneasy alliance to combat their mutual enemies? And is the key to defeating the tomatoes located in the heart of Africa, where they can't seem to get a clear foothold upon?

Travelling to Africa, Chad, Tara, Dr. Gangreen and Igor locate the one enemy that can defeat the tomatoes, the African Tomato Worm Tribe. Can they arrive back in San Zucchini to save the KTTF in what may be their last stand?

Gangreen begins his new plot to take over the world with a new creation named the Ultimato, armed with a brain cloned from the angry Doctor himself. They deceive the KTTF into thinking it's on their side but the creature has its own plans.
The KTTF and Gang of Six trade places which leads to the newly-tomatoed Wilbur and his team being on the run while the now-human Gang of Six plan on putting the African Tomato Worms on ice.

With humanity reclaiming Earth from the Killer Tomatoes, Fang stages an uprising and ousts Zoltan from the Gang of Six. Zoltan forms a alliance once more with Dr. Gangreen, who creates five new tomatoes to fight against Fang's crew.
